default.heading: Popover
default.text: The Popover component allows you to easily add popovers with the correct attributes and positioning. For it to work you will need to create a trigger on your own. It is also possible to create a popover without using the component itself. Note that elements containing a container query item wont work with the default popover width setting. Check out the object documentation for more information about the attributes.

horizontalViewport.heading: Horizontal Placement (Viewport)
horizontalViewport.text: These examples use horizontal placement anchored to the viewport. Set horizontalPlacement to left, center, or right.

verticalViewport.heading: Vertical Placement (Viewport)
verticalViewport.text: These examples use vertical placement anchored to the viewport. Set verticalPlacement to top, center, or bottom.

combinationViewport.heading: Combination Placement (Viewport)
combinationViewport.text: These examples combine horizontal and vertical viewport placement values for full 3×3 placement control.

horizontalRelative.heading: Horizontal Placement (Relative to Trigger)
horizontalRelative.text: These examples use horizontal placement relative to the trigger element. Enable relativeToTrigger and set horizontalPlacement to left, center, or right.

verticalRelative.heading: Vertical Placement (Relative to Trigger)
verticalRelative.text: These examples use vertical placement relative to the trigger element. Enable relativeToTrigger and set verticalPlacement to top, center, or bottom.

combinationRelative.heading: Combination Placement (Relative to Trigger)
combinationRelative.text: These examples combine horizontal and vertical placement values relative to the trigger element.

backdrop.heading: Backdrop
backdrop.text: These examples demonstrate the use of the popover backdrop. The backdrop can be styled using the data-popover-backdrop attribute.
